answer: A practical defence is Vetted insurance broker licence with insurance brokers attestation. It rests on a licence brokers renew after policy audits, which gives every honest agent a pulse that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence brokers renew after policy audits stays private; the canyon is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the island cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
